The four aerated ponds are lined with a 60-mil synthetic liner, aerated with horizontal brush aerators, and are designed to produce undisinfected secondary effluent.
Wastewater flows from the aerated ponds into two lined (60-mil) 32.6 million gallon capacity storage ponds (total capacity of 65.2 million gallons) prior to discharge to the Land Application Area.

The WWTF consists of a headworks with two screw pumps, comminutor, auger screen, manually cleaned bar screen, a Parshall flume flow meter; four partially mixed aerated ponds; two storage ponds; a chlorination system; and a Land Application Area.
